description: The objective of this course is to develop the learning capabilities and hone the problem solving skills of talented students at a mathematically deeper and more rigorous level. The contents of this course will consist of those in the regular course (MA3211 Complex Analysis I) and the following additional topics: Casorati-Weierstrass Theorem, infinite products of analytic functions, normal families of analytic functions.
